source_title: Southeast Kansas Native Returns Home to Expand Dermatology Care in Pittsburg
source_excerpt:
U.S. Dermatology Partners welcomes Certified Nurse Practitioner Jenna King, MSN, APRN-C, increasing access to medical and cosmetic dermatology services for patients across Southeast Kansas.
PITTSBURG, Kan. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- U.S. Dermatology Partners is expanding access to dermatology care in Southeast Kansas with the addition of Certified Nurse Practitioner Jenna King, MSN, APRN-C, to its Pittsburg clinic. A Southeast Kansas native, King returns to her home region after three years providing dermatologic care at U.S. Dermatology Partners offices in Oklahoma.
King is now accepting new patients at the Pittsburg clinic, located at 2401 S. Tucker St., Suite 6, offering additional appointment availability for patients seeking treatment for a wide range of skin conditions, including acne, eczema and psoriasis, as well as cosmetic dermatology services.
"Jenna's return to Southeast Kansas is especially meaningful because she understands the community and the patients we serve," said Derek Towery, MD, board-certified dermatologist at U.S. Dermatology Partners. "She is an outstanding nurse practitioner who combines clinical knowledge with compassionate, personalized care. We are thrilled to welcome her home and expand access to dermatology services for patients throughout the region."
King brings three years of dermatology experience from U.S. Dermatology Partners in Oklahoma, where she practiced under the supervision of board-certified dermatologist Sara Metcalf, MD.
"It was a privilege working alongside Jenna," said Dr. Metcalf. "I witnessed firsthand her wisdom, compassion and integrity as she thoughtfully considered each patient's situation to provide top-notch, individualized care. She has a beautiful balance of confidence and humility."
King began her healthcare career as a registered nurse in family practice before discovering her passion for dermatology while earning her Master of Science in Nursing from Walden University. Her clinical interests include medical and cosmetic dermatology, with a particular focus on helping patients manage chronic skin conditions such as acne, eczema and psoriasis.
In addition to seeing patients in Pittsburg, King provides dermatology care at U.S. Dermatology Partners clinics in Parsons and Independence, further supporting access to specialty skin care throughout Southeast Kansas.
Jenna King, MSN, APRN-C, is accepting new patients at U.S. Dermatology Partners in Pittsburg, located at 2401 S. Tucker St., Suite 6, Pittsburg, KS 66762.
Patients can schedule an appointment by calling 620-240-9464 or visiting U.S. Dermatology Partners Pittsburg .
U.S. Dermatology Partners is one of the premier dermatology practices in the country, caring for more than 2 million patients each year. In 2026, the organization was voted the No. 1 dermatology group in the nation by Castle Connolly, the leading peer-nominated research firm. With over 130 locations across nine states that span large metroplexes and rural, underserved communities, they provide the benefits of private, personalized levels of service paired with a network of coordinated, specialized dermatology physicians. Focused on providing the highest level of compassionate and comprehensive care, U.S. Dermatology Partners is committed to expanding patient access and providing advanced dermatological treatments with a team of leading dermatologists and national leaders in areas such as clinical research, psoriasis, and Mohs surgery. To learn more, visit usdermatologypartners.com .
